scope: Owner-only Friend connection profiles and transport switching
rules: AUTO prefers direct FriendRuntime and may fall back to HTTP 8790
8790 is an optional transport boundary, not the canonical execution layer
passwords are never stored in profile JSON
iOS clients use Keychain-backed secure storage and may send credentials transiently for a test/chat request
server-side persistent credentials are optional and Windows-only DPAPI protected
a failed transport is reported; mock success is forbidden
three consecutive transport failures open a short circuit
Render is outside this connection architecture
transport identity is returned with every successful chat
mobile clients must not assume 127.0.0.1 refers to the Windows Friend host
